Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 x number;
 y number;
v_print number;
al_id alert := find_alert('CHOICE_ALERT');
al_button number;
begin
if :rpt_parm.action_desc in('R', 'P') then
 Select count(*) into x from rpt_report_names 
 where report_type = 'GUI' and appl_id = :rpt_parm.appl_id and
 report_name = :rpt_parm.report_name; 
 
 
 if x > 0 then
 show_error('9520');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end if;
if :rpt_parm.action_desc = 'P' then
 select count(*) into y from rpt_report_names
 where report_type != 'GUI' and appl_id = :rpt_parm.appl_id and
 report_name = :rpt_parm.report_name;
 
 
 if y > 0 then
 if :rpt_parm.print_id is null then
 :rpt_parm.print_id := :ctrl_block_1.user_printer_id;
 end if; 
 set_alert_property(al_id, alert_message_text, 'This report will be printed on'||' '||:rpt_parm.print_id||' '||'printer');
 al_button := Show_Alert(al_id);
 if al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 execute_trigger('KEY-COMMIT');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 go_item('rpt_parm.action_desc');
 end if;
 
 end if;
 end if;
 if :rpt_parm.action_desc = 'R' then
 execute_trigger('KEY-COMMIT');
 check_package_failure;
end if;
 if :rpt_parm.action_desc = 'D' then
 execute_trigger('KEY-COMMIT');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
/* begin
 select print_id, forms_type, '0'
 into :rpt_parm.print_id, :rpt_parm.display_forms_type , 
 :rpt_parm.echo_count
 from rpt_report_names
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and report_name = :rpt_parm.report_name;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
*/

Declare
 v_local_time date;--timestamp;
 v_local_time1 date;
Begin
 
 /* Convert GMT hh:mi into local time hh:mi for submit_date and end_date*/
 --if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 if :global.time_zone_enabled ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:rpt_parm.submit_date,v_local_time);
 :rpt_parm.ctrl_submit_date :=v_local_time;
 
 else
 :rpt_parm.ctrl_submit_date :=:rpt_parm.submit_date;
 
 end if;
 
 if :global.time_zone_enabled='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:rpt_parm.end_date,v_local_time1);
 
 :rpt_parm.ctrl_end_date:=v_local_time1;
 
 else
 :rpt_parm.ctrl_end_date:=:rpt_parm.end_date;
 end if;
End;
 
 begin
 select forms_type, '0'
 into :rpt_parm.display_forms_type , 
 :rpt_parm.echo_count
 from rpt_report_names
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and report_name = :rpt_parm.report_name;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
--
 if :report_status = 'C'
 then
 :dis_report_status := 'Completed';
 
 --:time_taken := (:end_date - :submit_date)*24*60*60;-- Original Commented
 :time_taken := (:rpt_parm.ctrl_end_date - :rpt_parm.ctrl_submit_date)*24*60*60;
 
-- 
 elsif :report_status = 'S'
 then
 :dis_report_status := 'Submitted';
 elsif :report_status = 'E'
 then
 :dis_report_status := 'Executing';
 elsif :report_status = 'Q'
 then
 :dis_report_status := 'Queued';
 else 
 :dis_report_status := 'Unknown';
 end if;
 begin
 select title, subtitle
 into :rpt_parm.title, :rpt_parm.subtitle
 from rpt_report_names
 where report_name = :rpt_parm.report_name
 and appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :rpt_parm.title := '';
 :rpt_parm.subtitle := '';
 end;

end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 filename VARCHAR2(50) := NULL;
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 pl_name varchar2(50) := 'rptname' ;
 pl_id ParamList ;
begin
 enter;
 check_package_failure;
/*
 if :report_status in ('E','S') then
 message('Err: Cannot perform action on Executing reports');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if; 
*/
--
 if :action not in ('R','D','P','L') then
 show_error('18017');
 check_package_failure;
 /* else
 if :rpt_parm.print_id is null then
 :rpt_parm.print_id := :ctrl_block_1.user_printer_id;
 end if;*/
 end if;
 --
 if :rpt_parm.rowid is null then
 show_error('9506');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 --
 /*if :action != 'D' then
 if :report_status != 'C' then
 show_error('19109');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;*/
 --
 filename := :rpt_parm.report_name ||
 '_' || :parm_id || '_' || :rpt_parm.user_name ||'.r';
-- message('filename'||' '||filename);pause;

 /* filename := '$REPOUTPUT/' || :report_name ||
 '_' || :parm_id || '_' || :rpt_parm.user_name ||'.r';*/
 --
 -- message('action'||' '||:rpt_parm.action);pause;
 if :action = 'R' then
 pl_id := get_parameter_list(pl_name);
 if not id_null(pl_id) then
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;
 pl_id := create_parameter_list(pl_name) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.report_name) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_PARM_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parm_id) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.user_name) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_FORM_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :rpt_parm.display_forms_type);
 add_parameter(pl_id, 'P_PRINT_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, nvl(:rpt_parm.print_id,:ctrl_block_1.user_printer_id));
 add_parameter(pl_id, 'P_APPL_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :rpt_parm.appl_id);
 call_form( lower('LTQRVIEW') ,HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
 
 /* command := 'C:\acrobat3\reader\acrord32.exe '||filename ;
 host(command);return;
 command := get_review_command (filename ,
 :rpt_parm.display_forms_type );*/
 elsif :action = 'D' then
 command := get_delete_command (filename);
 elsif :action = 'P' then
 command := get_print_command (filename,
 :rpt_parm.display_forms_type,
 :rpt_parm.print_id ,
 :ctrl_block_1.user_printer_id );
 elsif :action = 'L' then
 command := get_locprint_command (filename,
 :rpt_parm.display_forms_type );
 end if;
 --message('command'||' '||command);pause;
 if command = 'SUCCESS' then
 :system.message_level := 10;
 commit;
 show_error('9163');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 clear_block(no_validate);
 execute_query;
 end if;
 --host_command (command );
 :action := null;
 :action_desc := null;
end;

 then

 else

 then

 end if;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PRINT_COMMAND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
function get_print_command ( filename in VARCHAR2,
 form_type in VARCHAR2,
 printer_id in VARCHAR2,
 user_printer_id in VARCHAR2 )
return VARCHAR2 is
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
begin
 :system.message_level := '10';
 -- this commit is must for committing rpt_parm table
 -- and then print request should be submitted
 commit_form;
 :system.message_level := '10';
 insert into print_request_queue
 (file_name,
 form_type,
 printer_name,
 request_date,
 no_of_copies)
 values
 (:rpt_parm.report_name ||
 '_' || :parm_id || '_' || :rpt_parm.user_name ||'.r',

 :rpt_parm.display_forms_type,
 nvl(:rpt_parm.print_id,:ctrl_block_1.user_printer_id) ,
 sysdate,
 1);
 --:system.message_level := '5' ;
 --commit ;
 --:system.message_level := '0' ;
 --message('Msg: Report is Printing ...',no_acknowledge);
 return 'SUCCESS';
end;

PROCEDURE set_control_block_items( action in varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK_1.USER_NAME' then
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.user_name',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK_1.REPORT_NAME' then
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.report_name',action);
 end if;

 if action = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_user_name',ENABLED,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_report_name',ENABLED,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_retrieve',ENABLED,property_true);
 else
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_user_name',ENABLED,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_report_name',ENABLED,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_retrieve',ENABLED,property_false);
 end if; 

END;

RecordGroup.Name: RPT_PARM_DISPLAY_FOR_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code,code_desc from rpt_master_codes where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id and code_type = 'FORM' order by code

RecordGroup.Name: RPT_PARM_PRINTER_ID_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select substr(code,1,25) code,code_desc from rpt_master_codes where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id and code_type = 'LP' order by code

RecordGroup.Name: RG_REPORT_NAME
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select a.report_name, a.title from rpt_report_names a where exists ( select b.report_name from rpt_parm b where b.submit_date is not null and b.user_name = nvl( :ctrl_block_1.user_name, b.user_name) and b.report_name = a.report_name)

RecordGroup.Name: RG_USER_NAME
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select user_id, initcap(user_last_name||', '||user_first_name) name
from system_users where user_id in ( select user_id from fcn_grp_priv where grp_id = decode(:ctrl_block_1.grp_id,'ADM00',grp_id,:ctrl_block_1.grp_id) ) order by 2

DECLARE

 l_print_id VARCHAR2(40);
 l_error VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
